principles: A requirement has independent definition maturity and evidence coverage.
Registered evidence linkage does not by itself mean the requirement is qualified.
OPEN/PARTIAL/CANDIDATE release blockers remain blockers even if supporting evidence exists.
A solver/method qualification is supporting evidence unless it directly evaluates the released acceptance criterion on the released input/baseline envelope.
Physical qualification remains required where the verification method requires bench/inspection/leak testing.

target_schema.supporting_evidence_ids: method, model, literature, screening or intermediate evidence
target_schema.qualifying_evidence_ids: evidence that evaluates the released acceptance criterion on the applicable baseline/envelope
target_schema.acceptance: numeric or otherwise objectively decidable release criterion

transitional_rule: Existing evidence_ids is treated as registered linkage only. Do not infer qualifying status from it until explicit evidence roles are migrated.
current_priority_after_P0: REQ-K01-ACT-FORCE-001: define released numeric acceptance first, then classify existing FEMM method evidence as supporting and later attach tolerance/temperature/driver/breakaway + bench evidence as qualifying.
